defect: The new TryCastValue calls evaluate StringValue::Get(dummy_val) unconditionally, which throws an InternalException when the header cell is NULL.
reason: The change itself passes dummy_val.IsNull() next to StringValue::Get(dummy_val), and the fix only guards the Get with a null check, so the crash comes from the added lines.

defect: initial_format_candidates compares the candidate list with the unfiltered template list although the same change re-enabled filtering of ISO formats, so the reset never triggers for the dash separator, and the new early-return path leaves the failed date format set on the candidate.
reason: The fix compares against the actually initialized candidate list and adds SetDateFormat(candidate, empty) to the early-return branch, both repairing lines this change added.

defect: HandleText calls max_length.GetIndex() even when no max_length is set (the default), and optional_idx::GetIndex throws on an unset index, so every prompt without max_length throws.
reason: The fix adds an early return when max_length is not valid, inside the HandleText function this change introduced.

defect: The new foreign-key binding resolves the referenced columns but never checks that they have a PRIMARY KEY or UNIQUE index, so an FK on non-key columns is accepted and later verification finds no matching index and does not enforce the constraint.
reason: This commit implements FK. The fix (issue 3352) adds the missing index check to this binding code and repairs the index selection in data_table.cpp, which came from the same feature.

defect: The fix only removes a redundant std::move around a prvalue (sel_entry->Copy()), which triggers clang's pessimizing-move warning on OSX.
reason: The moved temporary is semantically correct and compiles in the default configuration, so the fix is a warning or style cleanup, not a repair of a functional defect.

defect: The added D_ASSERT(heap_ptr - heap_handle->Ptr() > 0) fails for the first heap entry, whose offset is legitimately 0, so debug builds abort during external variable-size merge sorts.
reason: The fix relaxes the newly added assertions to >= 0, so the wrong assertion is in this change's lines.

defect: The change removed the subquery-parameter binding path for non in-out table functions and throws instead, which breaks python_map, a function that takes a TABLE subquery argument through that path.
reason: The fix restores the removed subquery binding for functions whose first argument is TABLE, noting that python_map uses it, so the regression comes from the lines this change deleted and replaced.

defect: Changing Relation::context from a RelationContextWrapper object to shared_ptr<ClientContextWrapper> broke the Python package, whose pyrelation.cpp still calls rel->context.TryGetContext(), and left the polymorphic wrapper hierarchy without a virtual base destructor.
reason: The fix commit (Fix python build) updates the caller to context-> and adds the virtual destructor and override, repairing a compile failure caused by the interface lines this change changed; its edit to this file is only the override part.

defect: In the new ParseRangeVar, the no-schema branch assigns name = input instead of the parsed entry, so a quoted name keeps its quote characters.
reason: The fix changes that one line to name = entry inside the function this change added.

defect: The regenerated function list registers ListSliceFun and ArraySliceFun as single functions, and the generated header declares GetFunction(), although array_slice.cpp still defines ListSliceFun::GetFunctions() returning a ScalarFunctionSet, so the build fails.
reason: The fix restores the _SET macros and the GetFunctions declaration, reverting exactly the lines this change altered.

defect: The new bloom filter pushdown is gated on join_condition.size() == 1 (pushdown-eligible conditions) instead of the hash table's condition count, and it always filters NULLs, so for multi-key hash tables or NULL-equal joins it can drop matching rows.
reason: The fix switches the check to ht->conditions.size() == 1 and passes the null-equality setting to the BloomFilter, both in the block this change added.

defect: The new constant-NULL array fast path calls new_child.validity.SetAllInvalid(count * array_size) after the change removed the sized validity Initialize, so the mask is allocated for only STANDARD_VECTOR_SIZE bits and the write overruns it; nested children are also left inconsistent.
reason: The fix removes this fast path (commit title: more like wrong path), which this change added.

defect: CreateNode still calls GetMetricAsString(OPERATOR_TYPE) for the depth-0 root before overriding the name, but the same commit erases OPERATOR_TYPE from the root's settings, so the call throws a metric-not-enabled InternalException.
reason: The fix only queries OPERATOR_TYPE when depth > 0; the failing call ordering was introduced together with the query_profiler change in this commit.

defect: CreateValuesUnion reads the union tag as int8_t although union_tag_t is uint8_t and unions allow up to 256 members, so tags of 128 and above become negative and never match member_idx (and the comparison mixes signedness).
reason: The fix changes the cast to uint8_t in the function this change added.

defect: The new initialization of cached_cast_vectors iterates over all layout types, while ScanAtIndex and Gather index them by output position (column_ids), so a projected or reordered scan pairs columns with the wrong cast vector; the scan loop also uses result.ColumnCount().
reason: The fix builds the caches per entry of column_ids and restores the loop bound, correcting the lines this wip change added and activated.

defect: InnerAnalyze binds row = column.__getitem__ before a pandas Series is converted to its __array__, so row(i) indexes the Series by label rather than position, which breaks for Series whose index does not start at 0.
reason: The fix moves the __getitem__ binding after the Series-to-array conversion, which the comment right above it requires.

defect: The rewritten loop skips storage extensions that have drop_database and calls the null drop_database of the others; the removed break also makes DROP DATABASE fall through to the default case that throws.
reason: The fix flips the condition to == nullptr (and restructures the case), repairing the inverted check this change wrote.

defect: The new MapUtil::ReinterpretMap copies the input's vector type (for example DICTIONARY_VECTOR) onto the result without applying the dictionary selection, so dictionary-encoded map inputs are reinterpreted incorrectly.
reason: The fix slices the result with the input selection for dictionary vectors and sets the vector type afterwards, inside the function this change added.

defect: The new header includes generated_extension_headers.hpp under GENERATED_EXTENSION_HEADERS alone and drops the !defined(DUCKDB_AMALGAMATION) guard the previous code had, so the amalgamation build fails.
reason: The fix (fix amalgamation) restores the amalgamation exclusion in the guard of this new header.

defect: The added check rejects dictionary pages with num_values < 1, which makes valid parquet files with an empty dictionary page fail with Invalid dictionary page header.
reason: The fix relaxes the new check to num_values < 0 and handles empty dictionaries elsewhere, so the over-strict validation came from this change.

defect: When adding explicit template arguments, the change encodes interval_t::micros (int64_t) with EncodeData<int32_t>, truncating it and giving wrong sort-key encodings for intervals.
reason: Before the change the deduced type was int64_t; the fix restores EncodeData<int64_t> for micros.

defect: The new SetQuote returns early on an empty string, so a user-specified empty QUOTE is ignored and has_quote stays false, whereas the old code set quote to empty and marked it as set.
reason: The fix removes the early return in SetQuote, which this change added, after it caused a CI failure on empty quote.

defect: The new constructor SampleOptions(int64_t seed = -1), implemented in sample_options.cpp as seed(static_cast<idx_t>(seed)), builds optional_idx from INVALID_INDEX, which throws, so every default-constructed SampleOptions (Copy, deserialization) fails.
reason: The fix commit makes the constructor only set seed when it is >= 0 (renaming the parameter in this header), repairing the constructor this change introduced.

defect: The generated SampleOptions::Deserialize reads the int64_t seed directly into result->seed, which is an optional_idx, so it does not compile (and could not represent the -1 written by GetSeed).
reason: The fix reads seed into a local and passes it to the SampleOptions constructor, replacing the deserializer lines this change added.

defect: CreateProjectionReference now assigns expr.alias only when the alias is empty (an inverted condition), so the bound column reference never gets the expression's alias.
reason: The fix negates the condition to !expr.alias.empty() in the lines this change wrote.

defect: The new branch-free Subtract borrows div + 1 blocks with div = floor(deficit / divisor), so when the deficit is an exact multiple of the block size tuple_idx ends equal to the divisor (out of range) and block_idx is off by one.
reason: The fix (issue 19498) replaces this Subtract arithmetic, which this change introduced, with a RandomAccess on the absolute index.

defect: In the new range function, increment * current_idx and (end - current_value) / increment are computed in unsigned idx_t arithmetic, so negative increments produce wrong row counts and values.
reason: The fix casts the arithmetic to int64_t in the function this commit added.

defect: The fix replaces a local lambda, which is unused in release builds where D_ASSERT expands to nothing, with a static helper function to avoid an unused-variable warning breaking -Werror builds.
reason: This is a test-only change that silences a warning; no product code behaves wrongly.

defect: ScheduleOperator schedules each parallel task inside the ParallelScanInfo callback while total_tasks is still 1, so an early-finishing task can finish the pipeline before total_tasks is set, and it may finish twice.
reason: The fix gathers all task infos first, sets total_tasks, and only then schedules, which repairs the race in the scheduling code this change added.

defect: The reworked BuildPipelines orders the union pipeline after the current one only when the sink preserves order without batch indices, which drops the previous global preserve-order behaviour for order-dependent operators in the pipeline (for example LIMIT), so UNION ALL order is not preserved for them.
reason: The fix adds current.IsOrderDependent() to the condition and passes order_matters to CreateUnionPipeline, extending the condition this change introduced.

defect: The re-enabled macOS block tests flags & FileFlags::FILE_FLAGS_DIRECT_IO, but FileOpenFlags has no operator&, so the file does not compile on macOS.
reason: The fix replaces the expression with flags.DirectIO() in the block this change uncommented.
